options.label: File-fed board with edit-then-export checks
options.tradeoff: Keeps input explicit and testable, but requires agreeing on the board input shape before editing can be defined.
options.acceptanceExample: Given a small board definition supplied as input, when the exporter runs, then an SVG specimen-board is produced and invalid board entries are rejected with a message.

source.quote: Build a small editable specimen-board exporter for our SVG board utility. Board input and editing interaction are undecided.

options.label: Blank-board start with in-place editing
options.tradeoff: Makes editing central from the start, but leaves input validation open until the editing actions are agreed.
options.acceptanceExample: Given an empty board, when a user adds entries through the editing interaction, then the exporter produces the SVG board and re-export reflects the edits.

source.quote: Build a small editable specimen-board exporter for our SVG board utility. Board input and editing interaction are undecided.

options.label: Small change set on current board with validation
options.tradeoff: Limits scope to the smallest editing delta, but defers broader board-kind decisions to a later slice.
options.acceptanceExample: Given an existing board, when a user changes one entry and re-exports, then only that entry changes in the SVG output and an empty board is rejected.
